services.checkout-api: Java 21 / Spring Boot 3, HikariCP pool to inventory-db, 8-24 pods (HPA)
services.payment-service: Go 1.23, pgxpool to inventory-db, calls the PayFlow card-payments PSP
services.inventory-db: PostgreSQL 15 cluster (primary + 2 replicas), max_connections=400, hosts inventory, orders, accounts and payments databases
services.auth-service: Node.js 20 / Express, RS256 JWTs, sessions in redis-cache, accounts DB on inventory-db
services.notification-worker: Python 3.12 / Celery, SQLAlchemy, sends email + push via SMTP relay
services.redis-cache: Redis 7.2 with Sentinel, maxmemory 6gb, shared by checkout-api and auth-service
services.api-gateway: ingress-nginx in front of all public APIs at api.acme.shop
